description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation value across layers for different components of a model. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 21, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The first line, denoted by a dashed orange line with no markers, represents “attn_output” and begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 1400 until layer 18, and then declines to approximately 200 at layer 21. The second line, denoted by a dotted blue line with no markers, represents “attn_residual” and begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, rises to approximately 100 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 100 until layer 18, and then rises to approximately 400 at layer 21. The third line, denoted by a dashed green line with no markers, represents “ffn_output” and begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 1400 until layer 18, and then declines to approximately 200 at layer 21. The fourth line, denoted by a solid red line with no markers, represents “ffn_residual” and begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 1400 until layer 18, and then declines to approximately 200 at layer 21.
